title: Testing 6 Completely Different Gravel Bikes Head to Head to Find the Future of Gravel
content:
Gravel bikes are as varied as the people who ride them. We tested six completely different models at the Velo Field Test to find out where gravel is headed.

Read the full article at Testing 6 Completely Different Gravel Bikes Head to Head to Find the Future of Gravel on Velo.
author: Will Tracy
